title: Odd-dimensional Walsh spectrum of the Li-Kaleyski Theorem 9 family
summary: Determine the exact Walsh spectrum of every odd-dimensional APN member of the Li-Kaleyski Theorem 9 family.

formal_statement.body: For $q=2^i$, let $F^{(9)}_{i,m}:\mathbb F_{2^m}^3\to\mathbb F_{2^m}^3$ be $F^{(9)}_{i,m}(x,y,z)=(x^{q+1}+xy^q+yz^q,\ xy^q+z^{q+1},\ x^qz+y^{q+1}+y^qz)$, under the admissibility and APN hypotheses of source Theorem 9 with $m$ odd. Determine and prove its complete extended Walsh spectrum for every admissible pair $(i,m)$. In particular, prove the computationally observed Gold-like spectrum throughout the family, or identify and prove every exceptional spectrum.

scope.domain: Walsh spectra of the fixed odd-dimensional Theorem 9 trivariate APN family
assumptions: The function and polynomial root conditions are exactly those of source Theorem 9
$m$ and hence the total dimension $3m$ are odd
scope.unresolved_remainder: A 2026 preprint identifies the source family inside a triprojective family and proves support and fixed nonzero Walsh magnitude in odd dimension. Walsh inversion then determines the signed multiplicities, so the preprint appears to cover the complete source scope; peer-reviewed confirmation of that claim remains absent.
